name: Kunstmuseum Basel
funding: Canton Basel-Stadt and the Emanuel Hoffmann, Christoph Merian and Laurenz foundations. UBS is partner; Novartis, KPMG, Trafina and the Federal Office of Culture are sponsors.
watch: UBS paid a $100M Federal Reserve fine in 2004 over dollar dealings with sanctioned states. Novartis paid $678M in 2020 over kickbacks to doctors.
records_note: It posts annual reports 2010 to 2025 with accounts, names its partner and sponsors undated, and lists its Board of Trustees.

name: Kunstmuseum Bern
funding: Canton Bern and the Burgergemeinde's museum foundation fund it. UBS is main sponsor; Mobiliar and UNIQA sponsor exhibitions; eight funding foundations include Hansjörg Wyss's Stiftung GegenwART.
watch: UBS paid a $100M US Federal Reserve fine in 2004 for dollar trading with Iran and other sanctioned countries.
records_note: Annual reports 2016 to 2025 with full accounts, an undated partner page naming UBS, sponsors and foundations, and a listed foundation board.

name: Kunstmuseum Den Haag
funding: Gemeente Den Haag owns the collection and subsidises the museum. VriendenLoterij gives €500,000 a year. Mondriaan Fonds, Vereniging Rembrandt, Aronson Antiquairs and several funds also give.
watch: Governed under the Dutch Cultural Governance Code.
records_note: It posts annual reports for 2017 to 2025 with a balance sheet and income statement, names its funders each year, and lists the supervisory board.

name: Kunstnernes Hus
funding: Artist-owned foundation; about page names no funders.
records_note: It posts annual reports 2015 to 2024 with accounts, a named funder section and the board; filings for 2023 to 2025 are in the register.

name: Kunstraum Dornbirn
funding: City of Dornbirn, Land Vorarlberg and the federal state, plus members and unnamed sponsors.
records_note: Lists its six-member managing board but shows sponsors as undated logos and posts no annual report or accounts.

name: Kunstraum Kreuzberg/Bethanien
records_note: Bethanien names its partners and funders on one undated page but posts no annual reports, accounts or board; its team page names two directors.

name: Kunstverein Bielefeld
funding: Nearly 1,000 members plus eleven corporate partners: Sparkasse Bielefeld, Hörmann, DMG MORI, Dr. Wolff, Gundlach, Bautra, Wannenmacher, Enderweit, jablgo, PGW Pecunia, Comspace.
watch: Founded 1929 and member-run. No Stadtwerke, energy or arms funder found. Board chair Andreas Wannenmacher.
records_note: No annual report or accounts; the about page lists the five-person Vorstand and shows eleven undated corporate partner logos.

name: Kunstverein Braunschweig
funding: City of Braunschweig, State of Lower Saxony, Member dues; registered non-profit art association.
watch: Housed in Villa Salve Hospes, an early 19th-century classicist villa; it commissions non-commercial contemporary work at domestic scale.

name: Kunstverein für die Rheinlande und Westfalen
funding: City of Düsseldorf and de Haen-Carstanjen & Söhne support it. Stadtwerke Düsseldorf is its permanent partner.
watch: Stadtwerke Düsseldorf is majority-owned by EnBW and runs gas generation.
records_note: The Kunstverein names its eight-person board and advisory board, shows sponsors as undated logos, and posts no annual report or accounts.

name: Kunstverein in Hamburg
funding: Ministry of Culture and Media of the Free and Hanseatic City of Hamburg, Member Dues; registered non-profit art association.
watch: Founded in 1817, one of the oldest German kunstvereins. Its programme takes on social and political subjects.

name: Kunstverein München
funding: Members' association; only project funders visible (Flanders State of the Art, Danish Arts Foundation).
watch: Its core supporter roster is not published.
records_note: No annual report or accounts; the board page names nine members and the sponsors page shows eleven logos with no names or dates.

name: Kuona Collective
funding: Artist collective cooperative dues, Ford Foundation, Triangle Network, international donor trusts; non-profit trust.
watch: Dedicated to visual art creation in Kenya since 1995; studios, metal sculpture workshops, and residencies in Kilimani.
records_note: kuonatrust.org returned HTTP 500, so nothing could be checked; a search found no annual report, funders or trustees.
